intro.fallback: At night, Mitsuki discusses the incidents with someone through a white snake, mentioning a Root heirloom and a possible user.
Mitsuki recalls waking up in a tank.
The Academy teachers have their students run an obstacle course in groups of three.

outro.fallback: Konohamaru and Moegi tell the students they'll occasionally drop by for the purposes of seeing who might be under their command, and encourage them to see which formations work better.
The boys discuss the recent lack of ghost incidents, and whether they should continue investigating now that they know the adults are also looking into it.
